_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 $8435-$8652: the cell lookup, the gun shot (type 2), weapon hits on cells and the A-button weapon wrapper. The generators subtract these.

regions.name: Cell under a point: the point
regions.description: CELL UNDER A POINT (slot `$8006`; X = an object; also entered at `$8443` with `$1A:$1B` set): `$1B` := x `$0530`, `$1A` := y `$0518` + the foot offset `$06B0`.

regions.name: Cell under a point: no cell in a corridor or below the room
regions.description: `$30` bit 6 (a corridor) or `$1A` >= `$C0` (below the 12 rows): class 0. (Entry `$8443` is also used by the gun with a point of its own.)

regions.name: Cell under a point: read the class
regions.description: Index = (`$1A AND $F0`) / 2 + (`$1B` / 32): the class map `$0400` holds two cells a byte, the even column in the high nibble; the nibble is chosen by the bit shifted out of `$1B`, which is column bit 0. `$6C` := the class; RTS. RUN: 1,500 random class maps, points and corridor flags equalled this reading.

regions.name: Object type 1 (the player's ship): handler
regions.description: A far call (inline `03 FF 7F`) to bank 3 `$8000` (-> `$8C98`, the player's code); the object's work is all in bank 3.

regions.name: Object type 1: return
regions.description: RTS.

regions.name: Object type 4 (the dying ship): handler
regions.description: A far call (inline `03 05 80`) to bank 3 `$8006` (-> `$90C6`). Type 4 is what the object loop's death check looks for.

regions.name: Object type 4: return
regions.description: RTS.

regions.name: Gun speed class by tier
regions.description: `81 43 82 83`: the value stored in `$0698` (speed 3.75, 5.62, 7.5, 11.25 px a frame).

regions.name: Gun metasprites, frame A
regions.description: Indexed by (frame counter AND 1) x 4 + tier: `25 27 29 27 / 25 25 25 18` (hex metasprite ids).

regions.name: GUN SHOT (object type 2): first frame?
regions.description: The type's bit 7 (set by `$CFA0`) skips the set-up and goes to `$84BF`.

regions.name: Gun shot: set-up
regions.description: `JSR $C0AE` (`$CFA0`) and the shot's attack `$05A8,X` := the player's `$05A8` (slot 0).

regions.name: Gun shot: direction and timer
regions.description: A := `$0788,X`, the direction the player set when it fired (0 right, 4 down, 8 left, 12 up); in a corridor (`$30` bit 6) 12 (up) instead. Stored in `$07A0,X` as the animation phase.

regions.name: Gun shot: velocity, collision, sound
regions.description: `JSR $C102` (`$F8CE`: direction to velocity with the speed class), `$0560,X` := 2, sound `$25`.

regions.name: Gun shot: every frame - the picture choice
regions.description: `$0788,X` is now a frame counter (++). Y := (counter AND 1) x 4 + the tier `$3A`.

regions.name: Gun shot: the metasprite
regions.description: When `$07A0` AND 7 is 4 the metasprite id comes from `$8488[Y]`, else from `$8480[Y]`: the two tables alternate the picture so the twin pellets of tiers 1-3 flicker (tier 0 is one pellet).

regions.name: Gun shot: move and collide
regions.description: `JSR $C08D` (`$CBE8`, draw / move with the velocity) and `JSR $C0B1` (`$D229`, the collision test against the enemies).

regions.name: Gun shot: the centre of the hit box
regions.description: `$1B` := (`$06E0` + `$06F8`) / 2 and `$1A` := (`$0710` + `$0728`) / 2: the box's centre, from the hit box the drawing routine just set.

regions.name: Gun shot: the cell under the centre
regions.description: `JSR $8443` for the class `$6C` (always 0 in a corridor); `$8513[class]` zero skips.

regions.name: Gun shot: hit a cell
regions.description: `JSR $8523` for the classes the table names (5-10 and 14).

regions.name: Gun shot: used up?
regions.description: `$0590,X` (the shot's hit points) zero removes the shot (`JMP $C048`); non-zero returns. A cell hit costs 8 hit points (`$85E6`).

regions.name: Cell classes a weapon reacts to: 16 x 0/1
WEAPON HITS A CELL (`$8523`, Y = the cell class `$6C`, `$1B/$1A` = the point, X = the shot): solid cells
regions.description: Class 14 or 9: sound `$21`, damage only (`$85E6`). The solid blocks and the room's walls are not broken.

regions.name: WEAPON HITS A CELL (`$8523`, Y = the cell class `$6C`, `$1B/$1A` = the point, X = the shot): class 5 (the sphere's cover)
regions.description: Class 5 sets the new class `$15` := 1 (a pick-up sphere), `$17` := 0, tile `$28`, and falls into the shared break at `$8541`.

regions.name: WEAPON HITS A CELL (`$8523`, Y = the cell class `$6C`, `$1B/$1A` = the point, X = the shot): break the block
regions.description: `$16` := A (the new tiles), `$19:$18` := the point, `JSR $C117` (`$FA96`: a type-`$30` blast, the new tiles queued, the class written), sound `$23`, then the damage. Entered with different A / `$15` / `$17` by classes 5, 6 and 10.

regions.name: WEAPON HITS A CELL (`$8523`, Y = the cell class `$6C`, `$1B/$1A` = the point, X = the shot): class 10 (a key door's cover): which door
regions.description: Class 10: `$15` := 2 (the warp ring's class), `$17` := 0. The point selects the door: x under `$40` is the west door (Y = 1); x from `$C0` the east (2); otherwise y under `$60` is the north (0), else the south (3).

regions.name: WEAPON HITS A CELL (`$8523`, Y = the cell class `$6C`, `$1B/$1A` = the point, X = the shot): west door
WEAPON HITS A CELL (`$8523`, Y = the cell class `$6C`, `$1B/$1A` = the point, X = the shot): count a hit on the door
regions.description: `$58,Y` -= `$10`: the high nibble of the door byte counts the hits left (3 after `$ED44`). RUN: four hits on one door `$33 -> $23 -> $13 -> $03 -> $F3`. Still covered (no borrow): sound `$20`, damage (`$85A8`). RUN: x, y probes selected the doors N, W, E, S as above.

regions.name: WEAPON HITS A CELL (`$8523`, Y = the cell class `$6C`, `$1B/$1A` = the point, X = the shot): the cover is gone: which picture
regions.description: The low nibble is the door's key; 8 (no key) goes straight to a floor (`$859F`). Otherwise `$10` := the key, `$11` := Y.

regions.name: WEAPON HITS A CELL (`$8523`, Y = the cell class `$6C`, `$1B/$1A` = the point, X = the shot): compare with the earlier doors
regions.description: Y from 0 up to the door's own index: an earlier door with key 8 or with the same key is skipped; any earlier door with a different key ends the loop with tile 4. RUN: doors (3, 3, ...) opened W with tile 0; (5, 3, ...) with tile 4. **The tile is the key picture `$ED44` built: `$00-$03` for the first key of the room, `$04-$07` for the second** - so the `$04-$07` 'bracket' of the cells notes is simply the second key's picture, not a separate object. QUIRK (latent): with three doors (a, b, a) the third compares against b and draws the second picture for key a; no room in the map has three distinct keys (checked for all 302 rooms), so it never shows.

regions.name: WEAPON HITS A CELL (`$8523`, Y = the cell class `$6C`, `$1B/$1A` = the point, X = the shot): tile 0 or 4
regions.description: A := 0 (first picture) or 4 (second), then to the break at `$8541` as the tile.

regions.name: WEAPON HITS A CELL (`$8523`, Y = the cell class `$6C`, `$1B/$1A` = the point, X = the shot): a cover with no door: floor
regions.description: `$15` := 0 (class 0), tile `$1C`, to `$8541`. Also the tail of class 6.

regions.name: WEAPON HITS A CELL (`$8523`, Y = the cell class `$6C`, `$1B/$1A` = the point, X = the shot): still covered
regions.description: Sound `$20`, then the damage.

regions.name: WEAPON HITS A CELL (`$8523`, Y = the cell class `$6C`, `$1B/$1A` = the point, X = the shot): class 10: choose the door from the point
regions.description: Reached with x of `$40` or more: `$C0` or more is the east door; else y under `$60` the north, else the south. (x under `$40` is the west door, `$8568`.)

regions.name: WEAPON HITS A CELL (`$8523`, Y = the cell class `$6C`, `$1B/$1A` = the point, X = the shot): classes 7 and 8: step down
regions.description: Class 6 goes to `$85E0`. Otherwise class - 1 is written (`$FADE`, `$C11D`) at the point: 8 becomes 7, 7 becomes 6; sound `$20`. (Class 5 and 6 were handled above.)

regions.name: WEAPON HITS A CELL (`$8523`, Y = the cell class `$6C`, `$1B/$1A` = the point, X = the shot): class 6: floor
regions.description: `$17` := `$55` (an attribute pattern), then the floor path `$859F`.

regions.name: Weapon hit: the damage
regions.description: The shot's hit points `$0590,X` -= 8, floor 0.

regions.name: Inline jump-table dispatcher (bank 6 copy of `$D6B0`)
regions.description: `ASL A / TAY` then pops the return address, pushes the entry's two bytes (target - 1) and `RTS`. Used by `$8650` (the 12 A-button weapons).

regions.name: Pay for a use of a weapon
regions.description: `$45` (the cost in chips): `JSR $8B8F` (chips `$4C/$4D` -= A, then `$E213`), then `JSR $C138` (`$FDAA`, the uses left) and `JSR $C072` (print `$3E`).

regions.name: A-BUTTON WEAPON (object type 3) every frame: does it pay by the second?
regions.description: Y := `$3C`; `$879A[Y]` bit 7 set (Grenade, Fireball, Repeller, which paid when fired) skips the payment.

regions.name: A-button weapon: the payment timer
regions.description: `$3F` is decremented; non-zero skips.

regions.name: A-button weapon: reload the timer
regions.description: `$3F` := 60 when `$3B` is 3 or more (one object), else 120 (two objects).

regions.name: A-button weapon: out of uses
regions.description: `$3E` zero removes the weapon: `$3B` under 3 (two objects) removes slots 3 and 4, otherwise this object.

regions.name: A-button weapon: durability
regions.description: `$07B8,X` (the lifetime from the level tables) zero: `$0590,X` := `$FF`, the weapon never wears out.

regions.name: A-button weapon: its own routine
regions.description: `LDA $3C / JSR $85F4`: the 12-entry table at `$8653` picks the weapon's routine.
